mapper.select: select count(1) from FIN_PRODUCT where FIN_PRODUCT.FINPROD_MARKET_ID = #{assetCode}

select fp.FINPROD_ID id, fp.FINPROD_ID text from FIN_PRODUCT fp
fp.FINPROD_ID LIKE CONCAT('%', CONCAT(#{search}, '%'))

SELECT DISTINCT A.PORTFOLIO_ID id, A.PORTFOLIO_ID || ':' || A.PORTFOLIO_NAME text, B.IS_GUARANTEE object FROM PTL_PORTFOLIO A LEFT JOIN PA_PTL_PORTFOLIO B ON A.PORTFOLIO_ID = B.PORTFOLIO_ID
A.PORTFOLIO_TYPE = '02'
and (A.PORTFOLIO_ID LIKE CONCAT('%', CONCAT(#{search}, '%')) OR A.PORTFOLIO_NAME LIKE CONCAT('%', CONCAT(#{search}, '%')) )
AND A.PORTFOLIO_ID = #{initValue}
and A.PORTFOLIO_ID in (select PORTFOLIO_ID from PTL_PORTFOLIO_AUTHORITY where USER_ID = #{loginUserName})

select FINPROD_ID from FIN_PRODUCT where 1=1
and FINPROD_MARKET_ID = #{marketId}
mapper.delete: delete from CREDIT_LINES_SEC_POSITION where PTL_ID = #{ptlid, jdbcType=VARCHAR} and to_date(#{valdate},'%Y/%m/%d %H:%i:%s') >= VAL_DATE
mapper.update: update CREDIT_LINES x set HAP_CREDIT_AMT = (select case when (x.HAP_CREDIT_AMT - a.TRADE_AMT) > 0 then nvl(x.HAP_CREDIT_AMT, 0) - nvl(a.TRADE_AMT, 0) else 0 end atm from (select SEQNO, sum(TRADE_AMT) TRADE_AMT, max(VAL_DATE) from CREDIT_LINES_SEC_POSITION where PTL_ID = #{ptlid,jdbcType=VARCHAR} group by SEQNO) a where x.seqno = a.seqno) where exists (select 1 from (select SEQNO from CREDIT_LINES_SEC_POSITION where PTL_ID = #{ptlid,jdbcType=VARCHAR} group by SEQNO) a where x.seqno = a.seqno)
